labels.rationale: Claims a deadlock in Rich's Live/Console locking; the report describes a bug.

labels.name: more information needed
labels.rationale: No runnable example, so the report cannot be reproduced yet.

items.body:
Thanks for the detailed analysis. To look into the possible deadlock, we need a minimal runnable example that reproduces it, without the Harbor, LiteLLM or aiohttp code. The stack dumps and lock-order reasoning are helpful, but they can't be run. Please include the output of `python -m rich.diagnose` (Rich version, platform and terminal), and a script that uses `Live(..., redirect_stdout=True, redirect_stderr=True, auto_refresh=True)` with threads or tasks that print or log during refresh.

Related earlier reports: #927 (deadlock when exiting a `Status`/`Live` context) and #3125 (redirected output during a transient `Live`).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
